confidence_semantics: publisher/source authority only; not parcel numeric accuracy

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue - vertical accuracy of the LiDAR data
verified_facts: EA specification requires absolute height error below +/-15 cm RMSE against Ground Truth Survey.
EA expects relative/random height error no more than +/-5 cm.
semantic_limits: Product/survey QC limits are not parcel-specific confidence intervals.
Exact parcel lineage is still required before applying survey-specific QC context.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue - Environment Agency data coverage
verified_facts: EA directs coverage checks to the index catalogue for product availability in each grid square.
semantic_limits: Grid-square coverage is discovery evidence, not proof that a target parcel intersects a specific survey feature.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue - projection information
verified_facts: EA supplies data in OSGB36 British National Grid with elevations above Ordnance Datum Newlyn.
EA says time-stamped and point-cloud data must use metadata catalogues for the geoid model specific to a survey; post-26-Aug-2016 surveys use OSGM15.
semantic_limits: Composite transformation context must not overwrite survey-specific time-stamped transform/geoid metadata.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue - opening and using downloaded LiDAR files
verified_facts: EA identifies LiDAR as a technical GIS dataset and distinguishes actual data use from simple preview viewing.
semantic_limits: Software/rendering workflow is not an elevation measurement or accuracy claim.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue - where to view and download metadata for all LiDAR products
verified_facts: EA states its catalogue covers England and directs users to metadata and coverage maps.
EA states that if no data is listed for a location it has not surveyed that location to date.
semantic_limits: A no-data conclusion requires a real target-location catalogue query; absence from an unrelated sample page is insufficient.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue - downloading large areas of LiDAR data
verified_facts: EA portal delivery is organised in 5 km by 5 km LiDAR tiles for open-data downloads.
Bulk country-scale download is not the normal portal path.
semantic_limits: Delivery tile size is not raster resolution, survey footprint precision or height accuracy.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue - LiDAR data metadata
verified_facts: EA directs users to downloadable index catalogues for product metadata including time of year of collection.
semantic_limits: Metadata catalogue availability does not constitute an exact target-feature match.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue - accessing the current LiDAR capture programme
verified_facts: EA provides a capture-programme application containing current and previous capture seasons.
semantic_limits: Programme status is planning/discovery context and does not prove the composite source used at a parcel.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue - point density considered in the LiDAR programme
verified_facts: EA gives typical minimum average DSM point densities of 1, 4 and 16 points/m2 for 1 m, 50 cm and 25 cm surface models respectively.
EA explicitly distinguishes irregular point-cloud density from grid resolution and notes DTM ground-return density can be lower under vegetation.
semantic_limits: Point density is not raster vertical accuracy or parcel uncertainty.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue - ASCII to GeoTiffs
verified_facts: EA moved 1 m and 2 m composite delivery from ASCII to GeoTIFF and supplies GeoTIFFs in 5 km tiles with elevations in metres.
EA identifies GeoTIFF as a delivery/storage format enabling web coverage services.
semantic_limits: Format conversion/storage efficiency does not create an independent measurement.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue - where to view LiDAR data
verified_facts: EA states the WMS Preview is an image of the data and cannot be queried.
Coverage Metadata WMS preview shows extents rather than the raster values themselves.
semantic_limits: Preview pixels must never be treated as official numeric elevation samples.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: Survey Data Catalogue - LiDAR data survey schedule
verified_facts: EA publishes survey-programme scheduling information and directs users to capture progress.
semantic_limits: Planned/current survey schedule is not historical source lineage for the 2022 composite or a parcel sample.
